requirements.desc: Every nested test command shall produce one typed execution record containing command argv, started/completed state, exit code, signal, error code, timeout state, spawn error, and bounded stdout/stderr captures.
requirements.note: R1: every child result serializes lifecycle termination and bounded stream fields

requirements.desc: Child outcomes shall distinguish passed, assertion-failure with concrete assertion output, nonzero-exit without assertion evidence, signal, timeout, spawn-error, and max-buffer outcomes through class-enforced invariants.
requirements.note: R2: numeric exits require assertion evidence before using assertion-failure

requirements.desc: Each captured child stream shall record original byte length, captured byte length, truncation state, bounded content, and a durable final-regression attempt-log reference when content exceeds the configured capture bound.
requirements.note: R3: UTF-8 stream capture is byte-bounded and reports truncation metadata

requirements.desc: tests/run.js shall emit one machine-readable child execution marker for every executed category while preserving existing stream forwarding, category order, summary, aggregate exit code, and exactly one spawn per category.
requirements.note: R4: runner emits one record per category without additional spawns

requirements.desc: The final-regression raw log and final-regression-result.json shall identify each nested command and its typed outcome, and the artifact shall expose bounded child records linked to the raw attempt log.
requirements.note: R5: final artifact and raw log preserve the nested typed record

requirements.desc: Final-regression shall set failureNature assertion and current-versus-existing attribution only when preserved evidence supports them; an unsupported attribution shall become unattributed_unknown_failure with no automatic existing-failure eligibility.
requirements.note: R6: unsupported assertion and attribution become a non-proceed unknown failure

requirements.desc: The change shall preserve final-regression execution count, pass/fail/skipped envelopes, retry behavior, record-and-proceed failed-state display, status/report transitions, config-derived command/timeout behavior, and issue-log side effects except for evidence-based failure fields.
requirements.note: R7: pass behavior and outer invocation count remain unchanged

requirements.desc: Automated coverage shall prove all child failure modes, bounded truncation and durable references, raw-log/artifact persistence, evidence-based classification, retained-surface behavior parity, and zero additional test-process invocations without requiring legacy artifact compatibility.
requirements.note: R8: truncated nested evidence keeps exact metadata and a durable raw reference
